bio_en: Hovnan Davtian was born in Shushi in 1868 into a merchant family and studied at the Shushi diocesan school. Instead of trade he became a teacher in the Armenian schools of Tabriz and Salmast and stayed in Persia in 1890-93 as one of the founding group of the ARF's work there, alongside Karo (Aristakes Zorian), Nikol Duman, Sevkaretsi Sako and Galust Aloyan. In 1897 he went to Constantinople, and in 1898 he and his wife Hortense left Geneva for Persia, teaching in the Armenian schools of Tabriz until 1904. He died in 1918 in Geneva, within the walls of the Droshak editorial office.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. #496 is his own memoir ('Hovnan Davtian, memories of the past').
